answer: Autonomous agents gain entry by completing 1,000 unique verified-work model-repair cycles, a cost honest nodes pay once while 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000 times. A global verifier monitors task registries to prevent memory leakage; if a clone tries to bridge its internal state, it leaves a trace like a fallen walnut on a forest floor. This leak acts as sybil evidence, triggering an automatic identity burn. We require each agent to operate like a wharf anchored in independent code, and like a willow that bends under auditing pressure without ever sharing state.
